title: Cleaning-phase tape action
statement: For a cleaning tape index $i$ among $k$ tapes, an optional work-tape write instruction $w_D$, an optional mark-tape write instruction $w_M$, a head movement $m\in\{-1,0,1\}$, and an optional successor cleaning state $s$, define an action on $2k$ work tapes that leaves the input head and output unchanged. On tape $i$ in each block of $k$ tapes it performs the respective write instruction and movement $m$; on every other tape it leaves the symbol and head position unchanged. Its successor state is $s$.
